In response, the Petitioner has filed the additional information vide affidavit dated 18.8.2020 after serving copies on the Respondents. The Respondent, Assam Power Distribution Company Ltd, has filed its reply vide affidavit dated 5.9.2020 and the Petitioner vide affidavit dated 15.9.2020, has filed its rejoinder to the said reply. The Commission, after hearing the parties on 13.4.2021, directed the Petitioner vide Record of Proceedings, to file certain additional information and reserved its order in the petition. In response, the Petitioner has filed the additional information vide affidavit dated 13.5.2021, after serving copies on the Respondents.
